comp-mr1tv44l.html: Building India's Culture-Forward Artist Ecosystem

comp-mr1u55rt.html:
The Shakti Collective is a culture-forward artist ecosystem company built to discover, develop and scale artists, stories and cultural movements.

​

Working across music, films, live experiences, learning, artist partnerships & original IPs, we create the ecosystems that help artists grow, audiences connect & culture move forward.

comp-mr1wdahm.html:
Artists today have more access than ever before, but building a lasting career still requires the right ecosystem.

​

TSC exists to bridge the gap between:

  • Talent & Opportunity

  • Artists & Audiences

  • Stories & Culture

  • Creativity & Sustainable Growth

comp-mr1y8j19.html: Our long-term vision is to serve 10 million artists and take 100 stories to the globe.

comp-mr1wnsbb.html: To build the world's most trusted culture company by empowering artists & stories that create lasting cultural impact.

comp-mr3vots9.html: A Note from the Founder

comp-mr3vr2q3.html: "The future of entertainment will not be shaped by content alone. It will be shaped by artists with a clear identity, stories that carry meaning, communities that believe in them, and ecosystems that help creativity thrive.

comp-mr3upy2k.html:
The Shakti Collective was born from a simple belief that extraordinary talent deserves more than visibility. It deserves guidance, opportunity, collaboration, and a long-term ecosystem that enables sustainable growth. Our vision is to discover artists, nurture stories, build cultural IPs, and create experiences that connect deeply with audiences. We believe that when artists are empowered with the right support, they don't just build successful careers. They shape conversations, inspire communities, and move culture forward.

​

comp-mr3wcvds.html:
Every initiative at TSC, whether in music, films, learning, live experiences, or original IPs, is driven by this purpose. We are here to build lasting value for artists, meaningful experiences for audiences, and a stronger cultural future for India.

This is our commitment. This is The Shakti Collective."

Through personalised mentorship, identity building, release strategy, audience development, live readiness, and long-term planning, the programme helps artists transform their potential into a sustainable and purpose-driven career.

A great film deserves more than a successful release. TSC Films partners with filmmakers, producers, and studios to build audience demand through strategic positioning, cultural storytelling, partnerships, release planning, and long-term IP development.
Our focus is on helping stories create lasting impact beyond the box office.

comp-mr3vnb3n.html: Founder & Curator, The Shakti Collective

comp-mr3ufej7.html:
Rohit Sobti is an entertainment strategist with nearly three decades of experience across music, films, artist development, brand partnerships, and cultural IP creation.

​

Over the years, he has held leadership roles at Yash Raj Films, Sony Music India, and Universal Music India, working with some of India's most celebrated artists, music properties, films, and entertainment brands. His work has consistently focused on building artist-first ecosystems, creating meaningful partnerships, and helping creative talent grow with clarity, purpose, and scale.

​

With The Shakti Collective, Rohit brings together his experience across the entertainment industry to build a culture-forward company that empowers artists, nurtures original stories, and creates opportunities that generate long-term cultural and commercial impact.
